meta.title: Custom Shirts & Printing in Elgin, IL | Imagine PPTP Prints
meta.description: Custom shirts, hoodies, hats, banners, business cards and stickers in Elgin, IL. Ready 24–48 hours after proof approval. No minimums. ¡Hablamos español!

hero.title: We print what you imagine.
hero.lead: Shirts, hoodies, hats, banners, business cards and stickers. Bring your design, or we’ll make one with you at no charge.

work.title: Fresh off the press
work.lead: Real orders we’ve printed for our customers.

services.title: What we print
services.lead: One piece or a large order, for businesses, teams and events.

items.title: Custom shirts
items.body: T-shirts for businesses, teams and events.

items.title: Hoodies
items.body: Pullover and zip-up, with your design.

items.title: Hats
items.body: Caps, trucker hats and beanies, embroidered or printed.

items.title: Banners and signs
items.body: Vinyl and fabric, up to 10 ft wide.

items.title: Business cards
items.body: Full color in matte, glossy or semi-gloss.

items.title: Stickers and decals
items.body: Vinyl for branding, vehicles and promotions.

steps.title: Send your idea
steps.body: Upload a file, send a photo or describe it. We take JPG, PNG, PDF, AI, EPS, PSD and SVG.

steps.title: Approve the proof
steps.body: We send a digital proof. Nothing prints until you say yes.

steps.title: Pick up or ship
steps.body: Most orders are ready 24–48 hours after approval. Pick up in Elgin, get local delivery or ship nationwide.

proof.title: What you can count on
items: A digital proof before anything prints
Same-day rush, for an extra fee
A reprint or refund if the print quality isn’t right

cta.title: Tell us what you need printed
cta.body: Text, call or email us in English or Spanish. Quotes are free.
